tiers.name: Warm
tiers.rules: Take turns. Do the rung or fold — folding ends the round and you pay for it. Clear the whole ladder and you win outright.
tiers.top: Drink 4 — you made them climb the whole thing.

rungs.t: Two sips, then tell them something true you've never said
rungs.d: Small is fine. True isn't optional.
rungs.f: Folding on the first rung? Drink 3 and sit with that.

rungs.t: Give them a compliment you've never said out loud
rungs.f: Drink 3, and they compliment themselves instead — at length.

rungs.t: Let them ask you one question. Answer it honestly.
rungs.f: Drink 4. They ask it anyway, and you answer anyway.

rungs.t: Kiss them somewhere that isn't their mouth
rungs.d: Choose well. You only get one.
rungs.f: Drink 4, and they pick the spot you were too shy for.

rungs.t: Take off one item of clothing
rungs.f: Drink 5 and lose it anyway — their choice which.

rungs.t: Sit on their lap for the rest of the round
rungs.f: Drink 5 and they sit on yours instead.

rungs.t: Name the exact moment tonight you first wanted them
rungs.d: Time, place, what they were doing.
rungs.f: Drink 6. They guess out loud until they get it right.

rungs.t: Kiss them properly. Sixty seconds. No hands.
rungs.d: Count it out loud if you need to.
rungs.f: Drink 6 and hand them the phone — they write your next dare.

tiers.name: Bold
tiers.rules: Same ladder, higher up. Fold and it's over — and the forfeit is printed on the rung you wouldn't take.

rungs.t: Drink from their glass while they hold it
rungs.f: Drink 4, and they pour you a bigger one.

rungs.t: Whisper the filthiest thing you've thought today
rungs.d: In their ear. A full sentence.
rungs.f: Drink 4. They whisper theirs — and now you owe them it.

rungs.t: Let them take one photo of you. Their pose, their call.
rungs.d: You don't get to see it first.
rungs.f: Drink 5, and delete one of theirs that you like.

rungs.t: Lose another item — and let them pick which
rungs.f: Drink 5 and lose two of your own choosing.

rungs.t: Sixty seconds on their neck. They stay perfectly still.
rungs.d: They may not touch you back.
rungs.f: Drink 6 and stay still while they do it to you.

rungs.t: Let them tie your hands with something in this room
rungs.f: Drink 6, and they tie you anyway, for twice as long.

rungs.t: Say out loud, in detail, what you want to happen next
rungs.f: Drink 7. They describe it instead, and you get no vote.

rungs.t: Two minutes. Their hands anywhere. You don't move.
rungs.d: First sound you make, you drink.
rungs.f: Drink 7 and give them the two minutes regardless.

tiers.name: Reckless
tiers.rules: Final round. Whoever folds here loses the night, not just the round.
tiers.top: Drink 6, and the rest of the night runs on their terms.

rungs.t: Finish whatever's in your glass
rungs.f: Pour a fresh one and finish that instead.

rungs.t: Down to your underwear
rungs.f: Drink 5, and they undress you to the same place.

rungs.t: Hand them your phone. They read the last five things you searched.
rungs.f: Drink 6 and answer any three questions they ask about it.

rungs.t: Beg them for something. Out loud. Convincingly.
rungs.d: They decide whether it was convincing.
rungs.f: Drink 6 — and they give it to you anyway, which is worse.

rungs.t: Do the thing they asked for once and never got
rungs.f: Drink 7. It's happening later tonight regardless.

rungs.t: Two minutes. Their mouth, wherever they choose.
rungs.f: Drink 7, give them the two minutes, and receive nothing back.

rungs.t: Tell them your filthiest fantasy — all of it, no editing
rungs.f: Drink 8. They tell you theirs, and you perform the opening scene.

rungs.t: Nothing left on. Stand there while they look.
rungs.f: Drink 8, put the phone down — they're in charge from here.

tiers.name: Close
tiers.sub: Hands where I can see them.
tiers.rules: Take turns. Do the rung or fold — folding ends the round and you pay for it. Clear the whole ladder and you win outright.
tiers.top: Lose an item — you made them climb the whole thing.

rungs.t: Sixty seconds of kissing. Mouths only.
rungs.f: Lose an item, and let them kiss you anyway.

rungs.t: Trace their whole body with one fingertip
rungs.f: Lose an item and lie still while they do it to you.

rungs.t: Take one of their items off using only your mouth
rungs.f: Lose two of your own.

rungs.t: Kiss them somewhere you've never kissed them
rungs.f: Lose an item, and let them find a new spot on you.

rungs.t: Sixty seconds on their neck. They may not move.
rungs.d: Any sound they make costs them an item.
rungs.f: Lose an item and hold still for the same treatment.

rungs.t: Get on top of them — and don't touch them
rungs.d: As close as you can without contact. One minute.
rungs.f: Lose an item. They get on top instead.

rungs.t: Undress them to their underwear
rungs.d: Slowly. Their hands stay behind their back.
rungs.f: You go down to yours instead.

rungs.t: Skin to skin, full length, nobody moves
rungs.d: Two minutes. Whoever moves first loses the round.
rungs.f: Strip to nothing, and they hold you there anyway.

tiers.name: Closer
tiers.rules: Same ladder, higher up. Fold and it's over — and the forfeit is printed on the rung you wouldn't take.
tiers.top: Everything you're still wearing comes off. They earned it.

rungs.t: Their hands behind their back. Two minutes, your mouth.
rungs.f: Lose everything but one item.

rungs.t: Let them blindfold you and touch you anywhere
rungs.d: Ninety seconds. You don't get to ask what's coming.
rungs.f: Blindfold them and do it instead — they set how long.

rungs.t: Take them to the edge of something, then stop
rungs.d: Read them. Stop before they want you to.
rungs.f: Lose everything you're still wearing.

rungs.t: Two minutes. Your mouth, below the waist.
rungs.f: Nothing left on — and they take the two minutes on you.

rungs.t: Say exactly what you want them to do to you
rungs.f: They decide instead, and you don't get told first.

rungs.t: Hand them total control for three minutes
rungs.d: You move only when told. No questions.
rungs.f: You take control — but they set one rule you have to obey.

rungs.t: Make them make a sound. Ninety seconds.
rungs.f: Lie back. Ninety seconds on you, and you may not resist.

rungs.t: Do the thing you've been thinking about since this started
rungs.d: You know what it is. Do it.
rungs.f: Tell them what it was, then let them do it to you instead.

tiers.name: All In
tiers.rules: Final round. Whoever folds here loses the night, not just the round.
tiers.top: They cleared it. The rest of the night is theirs to call.

rungs.t: Nothing left on. Both of you.
rungs.f: They undress you, and you don't get to help.

rungs.t: Take them right to the edge. Don't let them over.
rungs.d: Twice, if you can manage it.
rungs.f: They take you there instead — and stop.

rungs.t: Ask for exactly what you want. Beg if you have to.
rungs.d: They decide whether you've earned it.
rungs.f: You get nothing until you do — and they name the price.

rungs.t: Five minutes of anything they name
rungs.f: Give them ten instead, and they get to name it twice.

rungs.t: Do the thing they've asked for that you've never done
rungs.f: It happens tonight anyway. They pick when.

rungs.t: They're in charge until the game ends
rungs.f: You're in charge — and they'll make you regret not taking it.

rungs.t: Finish what you started. All of it.
rungs.f: They finish it. You lie there and take it.

rungs.t: Put the phone down and don't pick it up again
rungs.d: Game over. You know what happens now.
rungs.f: Fold on the last rung and they own the rest of the night — every call is theirs.
